title: Triangles seen on launch pads at Groom Lake

tellings.quote: I I know numerous people who have have seen triangles on launch pads at at Groom Lake

plain: Triangle-shaped craft have been seen sitting on launch pads at Groom Lake, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada. That is the claim of a researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb. He tells Michels he knows "numerous people" who have seen them, which would put such craft in the hands of the US military.
